Hi Olivia — great to hear the team liked the demo. Below is a concise playbook mapping milestones -> pricing -> billing triggers so you can share with Legal & AP. I've attached an editable MAP we can iterate on.

Summary (high level)
- Offer: 12-month commitment with staged ramp and milestone discounts.
  - Pilot (months 1–2): pay-as-you-go rate (standard hosted price) while we validate performance.
  - Ramp milestone A (month 3 target): 50% of committed QPS — unlocks 5% committed discount applied prospectively.
  - Ramp milestone B (month 6 target): 100% of committed QPS — additional 5% discount (10% total) once sustained for 30 days.

- Billing start date options (pick one):
  1) Signature date + invoice for first monthly cycle (standard)
  2) First production invoiceable request (we can start billing only once production traffic is observed)
  3) Start of calendar month following signature (AP-friendly)

- PO + invoicing cadence:
  - We accept customer POs. Invoices can be issued monthly in arrears.
  - Default payment terms: Net30. For enterprise customers with approved credit and an executed SOW, Net60 is possible.
  - For Net60 requests we require: signed PSA, PO on file, and standard credit references (or billing AM approval).

- Escalation and acceptance:
  - Evaluation acceptance criteria: 95th pctl latency within agreed SLOs, sample prompts pass your QA set, and integration recipes run end-to-end.
  - If acceptance not met after pilot window, we provide a remediation sprint (no additional invoice for the pilot period adjustments).

Next steps
1) Confirm billing start preference and payment terms (Net30 vs Net60).
2) If PO required, share format and billing contact; we'll include PO number on invoices.
3) We can draft a short commercial addendum with the staged discount schedule tied to the MAP milestones.

I cc'd Marissa (contracts lead) to help with any PSA redlines and to confirm the discount guardrails.

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Agreed commercial playbook (final)
- Commitment: 12-month term with staged ramp as in your MAP.
- Discounts: 5% discount applied prospectively when your usage reaches 50% of committed QPS for a 7-day window (Ramp A). Additional 5% (total 10%) applied prospectively after 30 continuous days at 100% committed QPS (Ramp B). 10% is the maximum aggregate discount.
- Billing start date: start of the calendar month following signature (customer preferred option confirmed).
- Invoicing cadence: monthly in arrears to accounts-payable@stellarhealthtech.com; invoices will include PO number when provided.
- Payment terms: Net60 granted for this account conditioned on: (a) signed PSA, (b) PO on file, and (c) Finance-approved credit hold release. If those conditions are not met within 30 days of signature, standard Net30 will apply automatically.
- PO handling: we will reference your PO number on every invoice. Please send PO to accounts-payable@redwood.ai and copy me so we can file it.
- Acceptance: pilot acceptance criteria (latency SLOs, sample prompt pass rate) must be met within pilot window; failure triggers a remediation sprint and pause of commitment ramp until remediation completes.

Operational next steps
1) Olivia: confirm PO pipeline owner and expected PO issue date.
2) We will prepare a commercial addendum (1 page) that maps MAP milestones to discounts and billing triggers; DocuSign link to follow.
3) Once PSA is signed + PO received, Finance will run credit checks and confirm Net60 release.
